desc:
THE HALLOWEEN UPDATE IS OUT, NOW!!!!

Survive hordes of zombies, battle other players, defeat epic bosses, and emerge victorious atop it all!

Refuse 2 Die is a faithful 1:1 fan remake of Reason 2 Die: Awakening, with additional original content. 

Join the Refuse 2 Die Community group to get +10 HP in-game!

Join the Refuse 2 Die Communications Server for updates, announcements, dev logs, bug reports, and much more. Major credit to PlaceRebuilder and all other original asset makers of Reason 2 Die: Awakening. This remake was made in tribute to their work and game legacy.

Current version: 0.2.1
